images.caption: The United States Navy sailor in the image is Seaman Justin J. Waters. I am the sailor.  I was assigned to the USS Columbia fast attack submarine. The photograph was taken during my visit to the Pearl Harbor National Memorial.  The USS Arizona Memorial and USS Missouri are in the background.

images.caption: (L) Japanese Naval Aviator Yoshio Shimizu, an Airman 1st class, and (R) a Japanese sailor.  Yoshio Shimizu was an Aichi D3A1 dive bomber bombardier.  The two-man crew of this second wave aircraft from the Japanese carrier Hiryu crashed December 7, 1941, possibly near Hickam Field.  Shimizu’s father was employed at the Waialua Sugar plantation until 1916.  His three older brothers were born in Hawaii; he was born in Japan after his family returned there.
